title: Lyric cut
premise: No captions and no narration — the song's own words come up huge, one at a time, and the subject moves in front of them. Built for a track with a vocal you already know.

shots.what: A wide establishing frame of the place, subject small or absent
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: The title word lands over this, so leave the middle of the frame open. Hold five seconds.

shots.what: The subject entering, mid-size in frame
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Subject between a quarter and a half of the frame height. This is the size at which a word can pass behind them and read.

shots.what: The main activity, close enough to fill a third of frame
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Closer than feels necessary. The masking that puts words behind the subject needs them to occupy at least 3% of frame, and further away than this it silently stops working.

shots.what: A fast detail — hands, gear, spray, a foot leaving the ground
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: One of three quick stabs cut back to back. Half a second each on screen, so shoot two seconds and let the edit choose.

shots.what: A second fast detail from a different angle
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Different angle, same energy. Whip out of it if you can — the burst reads harder when the frames disagree.

shots.what: A third fast detail, wider than the other two
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Widen to release the burst. Three stabs then a hold is the pattern.

shots.what: The subject travelling across frame, close
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: The best masking shot of the set: large subject, clean separation from the background, moving across the words.

shots.what: The biggest moment — the trick, the summit, the drop in
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: 4K60. The accent word lands on this one in red, so keep the centre of frame readable.

shots.what: A wide, calm frame after the payoff — the place without the action
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Let it breathe. After a burst, stillness is the effect.

shots.what: Straight down the lens, or the last frame of the place
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: The final lyric word sits here. Hold four seconds, centre of frame uncluttered.
